claimCorrectionNote: The first amendment parsed wider than it read, and that is recorded on the thread rather than quietly re-posted. `parseWriteScope` (scripts/lib/claim-scope.mjs:38-42) reads to the end of the `- Write scope:` bullet, and its disclaimer detector at :59 matches `no|not|never|except|excluding|outside|other than` -- my phrase was "Still excluded, unchanged:", and `excluded` is not `excluding`, so seven paths written down to DISCLAIM them were granted instead. Measured, not guessed: the refreshed gate listed docs/BRANCH_DISPOSITIONS.md, docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md, docs/RELEASE_STATE.md, docs/BACKLOG.md and three test files inside the scope. The same phrasing sat in every earlier claim on this issue, so the scope was inflated for every round of this lane; nothing was ever written outside the two source files (the gate measured "2 changed paths" each round), but the grant was wider than the text read. Cured by moving the exclusions into their own bullet and restating the scope with backticks around paths and nothing else; a second pass removed a backticked commit sha the reader had taken as a fifth path. The parser's blind spot is RECORDED here, not repaired here -- scripts/lib/claim-scope.mjs is shared governance and outside this landing lane.
overlapExclusiveNote: Exclusive for the bounded scope this lane mutates, measured rather than asserted. Every open PR was read file-by-file at this head -- #404, #400, #397, #395, #394, #391, #317, #306, #297 -- and neither `.claude/hooks/session-root-assert.mjs` nor `tools/entry/worktree-provisioning.test.mjs` appears in any of them. independentReview.reviewerNote: PASS on both Standards and Spec, and it VERIFIED BY MUTATION rather than by reading. Independent falsification on this exact head: after changing only one tracked file's mtime, diagnoseWorktreeProvisioning returned `clean` and the linked-worktree index stayed byte-identical (sha256 49602fdb... before and after) -- and the same probe FAILED on the reviewed predecessor, so the check can distinguish the fix from its absence. It confirmed remote branch, local HEAD and PR head all equal fdb57c03; base still f8c5f9d1; the diff still the two claimed paths; six directly relevant suites 6 files / 171 tests; `git diff --check` clean; scope-drift with --issue 405 measuring 2 changed paths inside the claim; and the full-gate log's own numbers. Spec PASS is explicitly for a bounded diagnostic slice: no repair entry point, no mutating authorization escape hatch, the SessionStart call site diagnostic-only, zero closing-issue references, and #405 open because its auto-repair criterion is unmet. Two binding conditions carried forward verbatim: "This PASS is bound only to fdb57c03eac41581a20ba363c92754296dbc4dde; any content change invalidates it" and "Keep #405 open and do not represent this PR as the automatic repair." Both are honoured -- the head merged is that exact sha, and no close-issue receipt exists.

whatLandsNote: What lands is a DIAGNOSIS, not the repair #405 asks for. Two files: `.claude/hooks/session-root-assert.mjs` gains a diagnostic-only worktree-provisioning check whose every git observation disables optional locks both ways (`--no-optional-locks` survives a stripped environment, `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0` survives a call path that does not carry the flag), and `tools/entry/worktree-provisioning.test.mjs` is its 33-test guard. Across four rounds the lane deleted every write path it started with: round 2 removed the caller-invented authorization object, the corrupt-lineage fail-open and both repair functions, because the caller was writing its own licence and docs/WORK_CONTROL.md's board carries no scope field to check it against; round 3 removed the last hidden write, `git status`'s opportunistic index refresh, which was rewriting the linked worktree's own index while the function reported clean.
issueStaysOpenNote: Issue #405 stays OPEN and is NOT marked Done. Its acceptance criterion -- SessionStart repairs the folder it is entering -- is unmet BY DESIGN. Automatic repair remains blocked on a machine-verifiable Work Control scope-and-overlap capability that does not exist yet: something that can measure a lane's real scope and its overlap with OTHER worktrees from Work Control itself. That is shared governance (docs/WORK_CONTROL.md and the board schema) and a different lane's change, deliberately not widened into this one. No close-issue receipt has been written, no commit in this branch carries a closing keyword, and `gh pr view 406 --json closingIssuesReferences` measures 0.
carriedForwardNote: Two findings observed by this lane and deliberately left unfixed, both outside the two-file claim and both owed their own issue: (1) scripts/lib/prepush-hook-contract.mjs has two fail-open shapes the differential corpus exposed -- `>&2 echo verify-local.ps1`, where the [;|&] segment split cuts the `&` inside `>&2` so the command word becomes `2`, and a multi-line quoted diagnostic containing the verifier name; (2) scripts/lib/claim-scope.mjs's disclaimer vocabulary knows `excluding` but not `excluded`, which is what inflated this lane's own claim scope for four rounds. Neither is repaired here.
